description.value: Jo's Italian Deli is a family-owned Italian deli in Vancouver's Kitsilano neighbourhood, serving homemade sandwiches on house-baked bread, fresh pasta with homemade sauces, espresso, and deli groceries sourced the same way the family eats at home. It is part of a small multi-location BC operation with branches on Main Street and in Chilliwack. Cyclists riding the Kitsilano and Point Grey corridors will find a filling, made-from-scratch meal in a casual neighbourhood setting.
